label: Wed, Aug 26
title: Nvidia Q2 earnings (after close) + Q2 GDP revision (before open)
body: The single biggest catalyst of the week for US equities — a read on whether the AI-infrastructure trade can keep extending, with knock-on effects across the whole chip complex.

label: Thu–Sat, Aug 27–29
title: Fed's Jackson Hole Economic Symposium
body: Central bankers from 70+ countries gather in Wyoming. Official theme is payments and financial innovation — the real question on every desk is whether the Fed is done raising rates.

label: Fri, Aug 28
title: Fed Chair Warsh's keynote + July PCE inflation data
body: Warsh's first Jackson Hole address as chair. He's avoided forward guidance so far, but this is the closest thing to a clue markets get before the September FOMC meeting.

label: Tue, Sept 16
title: Next FOMC rate decision
body: Markets currently see low odds of a cut. The August jobs report and August CPI both land before this meeting and could shift that quickly.
